request.style: English, gentle folk storytelling, male vocal with soft female harmony, fingerpicked guitar, accordion, cello, light percussion, warm and wry, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jonah walked through Nineveh, three days wide and tall
He shouted forty days and then your city's going to fall
The king came down from his throne and sat down in the dust
And the whole great city turned around, they put away their lust

[Verse]
When God saw what they did, how they turned from their evil way
He relented concerning the disaster and he spared them on that day
But Jonah sat outside the town and sulked beneath a vine
He said I knew you'd be like this, you're merciful and kind

[Chorus]
Should I not then care about Nineveh, that great city
More than a hundred and twenty thousand people
Who do not know their right hand from their left
And also many animals

[Verse]
The little plant that gave him shade, it withered in a night
And Jonah cried about the plant and said it isn't right
You cared about this plant, which you did not labor for
I care for every soul, said God, and so much more

[Chorus]
Should I not then care about Nineveh, that great city
More than a hundred and twenty thousand people
Who do not know their right hand from their left
And also many animals
